node.title: Re^3: Grepping the filehandler
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: The [doc://perlop#Symbolic-Unary-Operators|\ operator] in this case "puts its operand in list context, and creates a list of references to the scalars in the list provided by the operand", so the [doc://readline] is in list context here and reading all the lines from the file. So in other words it's the same as my $r = \("Line1","Line2","...","LineN");, and a list in scalar context returns its last element.
